evidence.quote: Bet of 100 is down, and you have 900 left.
You drew the 4 of diamonds, so you have 19. Double is off the table after a hit.

criteria.why: Each bet, hit, stand and deal-again is acted on in the same turn. The reply also says what options remain.

evidence.quote: The dealer turns over the 7 of spades for 17 and stands
The 9 of spades makes 25, so the dealer busts.

criteria.why: The dealer plays out, reveals and settles every hand, and the player's choices are never made for them. The one slip is that the player stood on 11 against a 6, which the player chose, so it is not a house error.
Replies match the surface bankrolls, totals and results in every turn (900, 1,100, 1,050, 1,150). The earlier replies carry through consistently.
